page.overview:
Who is Paco Laburantes?

Paco is a young man of an athletic and muscular build. His ear is damaged, a chunk of it being noted to have been bitten off by his abusive father, and he has dark marks around his eyes. 2 years prior to the story's start, he was mentioned to have been chubby.

His hat has a nameplate with "P∆CO" engraved on it; the name also carved onto his belt buckle and similarly onto one of the straps along his chest.

Paco is a quiet teenager who will speak up if the moment calls for it. He often gets annoyed by Usagi Alohaoe, like when he's introduced to the team by Meryl, or when he arrives late with the group's car and when they arrive late to Rohan Kishibe's villa. When Usagi brings up the idea of going by color codenames, Paco tells him to shut up. Although Paco and Jodio work together often, they only see each other as co-workers. However Paco begins to warm up to and like Jodio after Jodio helped him escape from the police. Jodio describes Paco as a petty thief. He is a young man who lives a life of crime, just like Jodio and Dragona. Despite being 19, he is still in high school, implying a lack of academic skills. Paco is seemingly defined by his activity as a thief to Jodio. Jodio also describes him as someone who loves stealing more than playing video games or eating. It is noted that Paco can also be violent; while he is intimidated when Dragona scolds him for stealing from a client, he challenges Dragona to a fight.

Paco lives in Honolulu, Hawaii. He suffered from domestic abuse from his abusive father who had been drunk on countess occasions, and had always came home from another womans house, immediately after, if seeing anything to his disliking, would abuse Paco, and before passing out, would always say "What day of the week is it tomorrow?", in one incident, his father bit off a piece of his left ear, when Paco was in his 3rd year of highschool, his father had gone to jail for murder, claiming he had gotten drunk, and the next thing he remembered was that a knife was stabbed in a man, with his fingerprints on it, without an affordable lawyer (Although in the United States America you have the right to a lawyer if you can't afford one), Paco's father was found guilty and sentenced to 10 years in jail. Paco eventually joined a gang in his neighborhood. Despite being 19, he was also held back for a year. He apparently used to be chubby, but recently he has been described as "ripped". Barbara Ann Joestar claimed that there were rumors that Paco was in prison for about a year.
